lem:algebraic-embedding-extension.scope: An embedding of the base of an algebraic field extension into an algebraically closed field extends to the whole extension; the base embedding supplies the algebra structure.
lem:algebraic-embedding-extension.clause_evidence: IsAlgClosed.lift is used to construct the actual field embedding in the absolute-value extension proof.

lem:finite-separable-part.scope: For finite L/K, the separable closure E is finite separable over K, L/E is purely inseparable, its degree is the inseparable degree, and [E:K] is the separable degree. The inseparable degree is positive, equals one in characteristic zero, and is a power of the exponential characteristic.
lem:finite-separable-part.clause_evidence: Finite-dimensionality and separability instantiate the finite separable extension construction; pure inseparability and the degree are used in power descent and completion comparison. The positive-characteristic power formula is called by extendAbsoluteValue. Characteristic-zero statements are exact imported specializations of the same generic construction, not separate project branches.

lem:separable-degree-tower.scope: Separable degrees multiply in an algebraic tower; the blueprint uses its finite-extension specialization.
lem:separable-degree-tower.clause_evidence: The project applies this theorem to the actual canonical tower of completed fields, producing the local weight multiplication used by finite tower compatibility.
